_note:
PhantomRaven (Koi Security Oct 29-31 2025): 126 npm packages, 86,000+ installs. Novel TTP: Remote Dynamic Dependencies — packages declare HTTP-URL dependencies pointing to attacker-controlled domains (packages.storeartifact.com). npm fetches at install time but registry-based scanners ignore the URL. Static analysis sees `0 dependencies`. Catch path: vetpkg's check_resolved_urls fires Signal::ResolvedUrlMismatch when a lockfile's `resolved` field points outside the expected registry host, regardless of integrity hash.

The corpus extension §2.1 also calls for treating any HTTP-URL dependency as CRITICAL; the v0.3 catch fires WARN. Severity escalation to CRITICAL for non-registry hosts is a v1.5 hardening item — fixture pins current behaviour so the change is detectable when it lands.
